candidates.statement: Checkout returns 502 after ~2s because the order service's calls to payment time out (ReadTimeout, transport error) at ~2s, exceeding the gateway's ~2s client timeout; inventory/redis calls succeed quickly. Payment-side latency is the bounded cause of the checkout failures.
candidates.uncertainty: No payment-side metrics/traces to confirm payment slowness vs. network; payment POST /v1/authorizations eventually returns 200 after ~3s, suggesting slow-but-alive payment.

report.explanation: Traces show inventory/redis succeeding fast while order->payment POST /v1/authorizations fails with transport ReadTimeout at ~2s, propagating 502 to /v1/orders and /v1/checkout. Gateway logs confirm 502s with ~2s client timeouts to order. Bounded candidate: downstream payment latency causing checkout 502s.
missing_evidence: Payment service latency/error metrics and server-side traces for /v1/authorizations during the incident window
Order service logs/traces showing where the ~2s timeout budget is spent
